mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT u.* FROM sys_user u
AND ( INSTR(u.username, #{query.keyword}) > 0 OR INSTR(u.nickname, #{query.keyword}) > 0 OR INSTR(u.email, #{query.keyword}) > 0 )
AND u.status = #{query.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id AND ur.role_id = #{roleId} )
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.user_id DESC
SELECT role_id FROM sys_role WHERE role_id = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET nickname = #{user.nickname}, email = #{user.email}, avatar = #{user.avatar}, intro = #{user.intro}, status = #{user.status} WHERE user_id = #{user.userId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blog_article WHERE author_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blog_comment WHERE user_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blog_file WHERE uploader_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blog_message WHERE user_id = #{userId})
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, role_id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = 'member' AND status = 1
